theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 := by
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_mod_of_lt]
  have h : n ^ 2 + n < 2 := by
    cases n with m
    · simp [Nat.zero_pow, Nat.add_zero]
    · simp [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_add]
      exact lt_add_right (lt_succ_self m) 1
  exact Eq.refl (Nat.mod_eq_mod_of_lt h)
